subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference & SilverLeaf Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@silverleaf.health>, Daniel Ortiz <dortiz@silverleaf.health>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference & SilverLeaf Health

Hi Sophie / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today. As promised, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to capture milestones, owners, and a target timeline so we can align across procurement, security, and the technical teams. This is a working draft — please flag anything that needs to change.

Recap (from discovery):
- Goal: 8-week pilot to validate inference latency & cost on patient-facing summarization flows.
- Primary success metrics: p95 latency < 400ms, token cost <$0.003 on average, and no PHI persistence outside SilverLeaf systems.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence requirement, procurement approval window, and data access provisioning for pilot dataset.

Draft MAP (high level):
1) Kickoff & scoping (this week) — Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) / Sophie Chen (SilverLeaf) — deliverable: finalized MAP + kickoff slide deck
2) Security review & evidence exchange (1-2 weeks) — Owner: SilverLeaf Security / Redwood Security — deliverable: SOC2 artifact checklist + secure evidence transfer plan
3) Pilot integration (2-4 weeks) — Owner: Aditya Rao (Redwood) / SilverLeaf Engineering — deliverable: pilot environment, API keys, sample dataset access
4) Pilot execution & monitoring (2 weeks) — Owner: SilverLeaf Product & Redwood CS — deliverable: results report vs. success metrics
5) Procurement & contract finalization (parallel, target close) — Owner: SilverLeaf Procurement & Redwood Sales — deliverable: signed SOW

Target close date (contract signed / production-ready): 2026-08-20 (flexible).

Dependencies / blockers:
- SOC 2 artifacts and evidence transfer window
- Procurement lead time and PO process
- Pilot dataset extraction and secure transfer method

Ask: Can you confirm the SilverLeaf stakeholders who should be listed on the MAP (security, procurement, engineering, product)? Also please confirm whether the suggested target close 2026-08-20 looks reasonable or if you prefer an earlier/later date.

I've attached the MAP draft: Redwood_MAP_Draft_SilverLeaf_v1.xlsx. If it looks good I can update owners/timelines and send a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Draft_SilverLeaf_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Redwood Inference & SilverLeaf Health

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the MAP draft — this is exactly what we needed to move forward. Confirming the SilverLeaf stakeholders to include on the plan:
- Security: Daniel Ortiz (security lead)
- Procurement: Melissa Grant (procurement manager) — I'll loop her in on the next thread once we finalize the MAP
- Engineering: Alex Rivera (backend lead)
- Product: Sophie Chen (product lead, I'm already on the thread)

Regarding timeline: overall the 8-10 week window looks fine but procurement at our org typically needs ~3 weeks after we submit the SOW. Can we aim for a pilot start the week of 7/6 and adjust the target close to 8/27 to account for procurement? Slight preference for 8/27.

Security asks: I'll share our SOC2 evidence pack (redacted) — attaching the requirements doc now. For the evidence exchange, can Redwood confirm preferred transfer method (SFTP or secure SharePoint)?

Next steps:
1) Marissa — update the MAP with confirmed SilverLeaf stakeholders and new target close 2026-08-27
2) Sophie — I'll add Melissa Grant and Alex Rivera after you resend
3) Aditya — can you propose 2 time slots for a 30-minute technical kickoff (week of 6/22 or 6/29)?

Appreciate it — excited to get started.

 Sophie
